comment: One preset per RAM tier. Every value below is a starting value from docs/plan.md phase 2 and docs/upstream-analysis.md Q7 and Q10; phase 2 (task 2.6) replaces each one with a measured value. Tiers are matched on total RAM in GiB: the highest tier whose minRamGb is not above the machine's RAM.

tiers.label: 8 GB
tiers.comment: Starting values, not measured. Chat model: 4B class Q4, smallest qwen3 tag of that class (owner choice 2026-10-29). Embedder bge-m3 for all tiers (Q10). Phase 2 replaces every value. Reranker off for now (rerankerModel none, selection by fused order with vectorFloor): onnxruntime-node 1.14 crashes with EXC_BREAKPOINT on the owner's Mac when a bge reranker loads (2026-10-30). sectionCount and vectorFloor measured on 2026-10-31 (docs/plan.md phase 2, retrieval tuning): balanced 5 / 0.55, strict 3 / 0.6, broad 6 / 0.5. Was Xenova/bge-reranker-base (16 GB), onnx-community/bge-reranker-v2-m3-ONNX (32 GB), Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 (8 GB).
